The downtown Allentown Neighborhood Improvement Zone redevelopment, anchored by the PPL Center arena district, exemplifies the kind of cross-functional, long-cycle project that requires skilled project management—work that attracts both local and regional PM talent.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Allentown

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of formal project management education hours. No prior work experience is necessary—a major advantage for Allentown professionals early in their careers or transitioning into project management roles.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required education into a focused schedule, letting you master PMBOK® fundamentals and exam content without lengthy commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the online application process to ensure your eligibility is confirmed before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study materials. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging concepts so you enter the exam confident in your knowledge.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units through continuing education, volunteer work, or additional PMI training to keep your credential active and your project management knowledge current.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
